items.title: Swap the M3 stand-in for the real module in wiring.dart
items.note: M3 is verified, but src/app/wiring.dart still constructs M1ProgressLogger (the temporary stand-in) at two call sites (~192, ~233). Replace it with the real M3 behind a thin ProgressLoggerPort adapter.

items.title: Make the repo a buildable Flutter project, so GitHub Actions can build the APK
items.note: The APK is now built on GitHub Actions (free, no operator machine). The workflow .github/workflows/build-apk.yml is in place. The repo must first hold a complete Flutter project (root pubspec.yaml + build.yaml + the android/ platform scaffold with the widget registered). Until then the workflow fails, which is expected.
